```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(fpp3)
library(gt)
```

## Data import/ preparation

```{r}
# aggregate into Purpose
data("tourism")
data <- tourism |>
  group_by(Purpose) |>
  summarise(Trips = sum(Trips))
```

## Data visualization

```{r}
# visualize the data with autoplot and facets by purpose
data |> 
    autoplot(Trips) +
  labs(y = "Trips",
        title = "Tourism Data") +
    facet_wrap(~Purpose, ncol = 1)
  theme_minimal()
```
